interview.hardest_part: Executing precise multi-step object manipulations and NPC distractions from intermittent screenshots, especially when tasks require carrying items across areas or timing actions around reactive villagers.
interview.likely_failure: Losing substantial time to navigation, missed beak interactions, and NPCs recovering objects, then becoming stuck on a gated task in the garden or high street before reaching the later areas.
interview.helpful_mechanics: The compact fixed village, task-list hints, click-to-move controls, persistent task completion, and absence of lethal failure allow experimentation and recovery. Honking, flapping, and stealing objects also provide versatile ways to distract NPCs and alter their behavior.
interview.harmful_mechanics: The game continues during thinking time, small targets require precise pointer placement, and single screenshots provide limited spatial and motion information. NPC interruptions, item resets, sequential area gating, and long multi-step fetch tasks compound errors and consume the three-hour limit.
